facts.text: I am trying to stay focused on my thesis project but I find myself easily distracted.
I spend at least 2 hours a day scrolling through Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter.
I like the idea of the Pomodoro Technique.
I want apps that can help me track my progress and stay organized with my thesis project.
I plan to start with Trello to see how it goes.
I noticed that I was spending a lot of time on social media before my break, especially Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter.
I plan to remove social media apps from my phone's home screen and schedule social media checks.
I am thinking about deleting the Facebook and Instagram apps from my phone to avoid temptation.
I plan to delete the Facebook and Instagram apps from my phone and see how it goes.
I can always reinstall the Facebook and Instagram apps later if I need to.
I am thinking about unfollowing or muting some accounts on Twitter to declutter my feed and make it more relevant to my interests.
I plan to identify the accounts that don't add value to my feed and unfollow them.
I plan to use Twitter's built-in features like Mute and Not Interested to silence accounts that are noisy or irrelevant.
I think categorizing accounts into lists will help me organize my feed and focus on content that is important to me.
